description: Rounded-rectangle closed pocket with vertical corner radius rc and floor fillet rf (rf <= rc), mm. Category (b): analytic; cross-checked once against OCCT 8.0 (cadquery-ocp 8.0.1.1.0) BRepFilletAPI_MakeFillet on the pocket floor edges, relative error 6.8e-12.

formula.removed_with_floor_fillet: V = V0 - a*(2*(W+L) - 8*rc + 2*pi*(rc - xbar))  (straight walls + Pappus around the 4 corners)

cases.reason: floor fillet larger than corner radius: formula domain rf <= rc; add_pocket must reject or clamp with a summary
